traits.name: Keen Ears
traits.summary: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing; pinpoint any sound you can hear within 60 feet.
traits.noEffect: Hearing-only Perception and sound pinpointing are not simulated.

traits.name: The Carrying Voice
traits.summary: Raise your voice to be heard clearly up to a mile away; two Dalvas can hold a full conversation across that range.

traits.name: Sundering Cry
traits.summary: Action, once per long rest: chosen creatures you can see within 15 feet that can hear you make a Constitution save (DC 8 + PB + Cha); fail 1d8 + Cha thunder and deafened until the end of your next turn, success half damage.

traits.name: Windborn
traits.summary: Ignore the effects of strong wind, including its penalties to ranged weapon attacks and to Wisdom (Perception) checks.
traits.noEffect: Wind is not a grid effect yet.

tools: one musical instrument of your choice

traits.name: Crier's Carry
traits.summary: When addressing a gathering, be heard and understood by every creature that can hear you within 300 feet; advantage on Charisma checks to sway a crowd of ten or more.
traits.noEffect: Crowds and 300-foot address are not simulated.

tools: one type of artisan's tools of your choice

traits.name: Fenstrider
traits.summary: Move across mud, bog, and other soft ground without sinking, and ignore difficult terrain created by marshland and shallow water.
traits.noEffect: Marsh terrain kinds are not simulated yet.

traits.name: Keeper of Memory
traits.summary: Double PB on History checks about events, peoples, or songs of the last three centuries; recall verbatim anything you have personally heard spoken, sung, or recited.
traits.noEffect: Knowledge checks and verbatim recall are not simulated.

traits.name: Highland Drover
traits.summary: Acclimated to high altitude; advantage on Constitution saves against exhaustion from forced marches and extreme weather.
traits.noEffect: Forced-march and weather exhaustion are not simulated yet.

traits.name: Canopy Carry
traits.summary: Carrying Voice is not stopped by wood, leaves, vines, or other biological forest materials; voice carries clearly 600 feet in any direction, including between forest layers.

traits.name: Layer Guide
traits.summary: By studying a forest path for 1 minute, determine which layer it runs through, obvious hazards, and whether travelers, beasts, or storms passed recently.
